verdict.rationale: Team sharing of TOTP codes is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents personal sync of codes to the user's own Google Account across their own devices, plus manual QR-code transfer between devices. Nothing shows shared vaults, collections, or per-member access control; QR export is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an IT admin, my team can share TOTP-protected logins through shared vaults or collections with per-member access control
